design_notes: Pilot 30 tasks are excluded from Formal 90.
Formal tasks reuse only the frozen validated Spark 3.5.9 rule whitelist, not Pilot prompt/constraint bundles.
Every Formal task has traceable real-case provenance.
Community/JIRA sources are provenance and ecological-relevance evidence, not correctness oracles.

R09 properties-file tasks use property-line artifacts; the Formal oracle/model runner places those lines into an isolated local custom properties file and supplies the safe --properties-file path itself.
Runtime-sensitive rules are asserted at the required depth (driver heap, YARN allocation, dynamic scaling/initial executors, queue, submit wait behavior).
No tested LLM was used to define oracle correctness.
Catalog is not frozen until 90/90 known-good oracle real executions pass.
